title: Maa Keh Rahi Thi Rokar Aye Jhule Wale Asghar
body:
Maa Keh Rahi Thi Rokar Aye Jhule Wale Asghar
bekal Hai Teri Maadar Aye Jhule Wale Asghar
1. Tashnalabi Pe Teri Qurban Jaun Mai Bhi
che Maah Ke Ghazamfar Aye Jhule Wale Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Sukhe Labo Pe Tune Sukhi Zaban Jo Pheri
rone Lage Sitamgar Aye Jhule Wale Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Tere Gale Pe Beta Mara Shakhi Ne Paika
hai Khoon Me Gala Tar Aye Jhule Wale Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Godi Ujad Gai Hai Ab Khaak Zindagi Hai
barbad Hogaya Ghar Aye Jhule Wale Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Naize Me Laash Teri Pinha Lahad Se Nikli
dil Phat Gaya Hai Dilbar Aye Jhule Wale Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Nanha Sa Ek Tan Hai Aur Wo Bhi Be Kafan Hai
laasha Pada Hai Besar Aye Jhule Wale Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Naize Pe Sar Tera Hai Jhula Bhi Jal Raha Hai
kia Karb Ka Hai Manzar Aye Jhule Wale Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Mai Kia Bataun Usko Tu Hee Batade Mujhko
puche Jo Teri Qaahar Aye Jhule Wale Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
9.khou Gashta Pairahan Ye Andisha Hai Fasi Ab
barpa Karega Mehshar Aye Jhule Wale Asghar
haye Asghar Haye Asghar Haye Asghar Haye Asghar
